label: Иначе
description: A 10-sentence usage card for иначе (otherwise, differently) covering manner and the 'or else' warning.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: The 'or else' warning. 'Иначе' means 'otherwise' and links a warning to the imperative, stating the bad outcome of inaction. It introduces a consequence clause.
Strategic focus: Differently in manner. 'Иначе' means 'differently' and modifies 'думаю', describing a different way of thinking. Here it conveys manner, not warning.
Strategic focus: A different method. 'Иначе' modifies 'сделать', meaning the task should be done in another way. 'Совсем' stresses a completely different approach.
Strategic focus: Consequence warning. 'Иначе' links the command to its result, meaning 'or it will get cold'. It is the everyday way to threaten a bad outcome.
Strategic focus: A different outlook. 'Иначе' modifies the phrase 'смотрит на мир', meaning he sees the world differently. The adverb closes the clause naturally.
Strategic focus: Threatened result. 'Иначе' introduces the consequence of not calling, meaning 'or else I leave'. It chains a warning onto the request.
Strategic focus: A changed state. 'Иначе' acts as a predicate meaning 'different', describing how everything has changed. 'Теперь' anchors the change in the present.
Strategic focus: Trying another way. 'Иначе' modifies 'попробуем', proposing a different approach. It suggests changing tactics after a failed attempt.
Strategic focus: Motivating warning. 'Иначе' joins a consequence to the command, meaning 'or you will forget everything'. It frames study as necessary to avoid loss.
Strategic focus: Hypothetical manner. 'Иначе' modifies the conditional 'поступил бы', meaning 'I would act differently'. It expresses a different choice in a hypothetical.
